claims.value: Rnj-1 is a family of 8B parameter open-weight, dense models trained from scratch, with `rnj-1` as base model and `rnj-1-instruct` as post-trained instruction tuned variant.
claims.evidence: Rnj-1 is a family of 8B parameter open-weight, dense models trained from scratch

claims.value: The base model `rnj-1` is capable of domain specialization similar to `rnj-1-instruct`.
claims.evidence: Both rnj-1 and rnj-1-instruct models are being made available for the community to extend
claims.section: ### Rnj-1 models are designed to be extended

claims.value: Agentic coding is a target ability for the model, with strong performance on SWE-bench.
claims.evidence: `rnj-1-instruct` dominates the pack on agentic coding, one of our target abilities.

claims.value: The model scored 20.8% on SWE-bench Verified bash-only mode.
claims.evidence: It scores 20.8% on SWE-bench Verified in bash-only mode, which is higher than Gemini 2.0 flash and Qwen2.5-Coder 32B Instruct under the same agentic framework.
